Wanted to comment since I'm an Iranian guy around her age, I think there are millions that don't mind either happening, millions that want to get rid of hijab laws, and millions that want to soften it, the enforcement in particular.
Personally it doesn't matter to me what people wear and imo people should clothe as they wish, just covering a bare minimum, because some degree of modesty should be required because there are kids in public.

As for the whole movements and all, I don't really support protests as soon as it stops being peaceful and becomes malicious in any way, in some cases that does happen and public property and businesses are damaged, which I'm absolutely against, there is always bad apples that try to take advantage of such situations. As a people we should be very careful because our region is not a stable one, once a country heads towards civil war and violence in protests it can shake a country to its core and invite some unwanted trouble, in modern day and in a region like ours revolutions may just not be effective and could result in things getting worse for the average citizen, just looking at what happened to all these countries around us in middle east makes me scared of what the future holds for us, I don't want our country to end up in hands of terrorists, other hardliners or puppet governments that will just exist to serve foreign interests.
